u.0.1.25.t: Ableton Live sets, FL Studio Mobile import, 32-bit plugins
u.0.1.25.s: LYNX SHARE opens and exports Ableton Live sets (.als), imports FL Studio Mobile projects (.flm) and loads 32-bit plugins on Windows. It also adds video tracks with ADR, VCA faders, automation lanes and modulators, loop-take comping and an optional Clip-launch layout.
u.0.1.25.n0: Ableton Live sets (.als): File › Open reads Live 11 and 12 sets, and File › Export › Ableton Live set (.als) writes them for Live 11 or 12 with the samples copied into the set's project folder. Import brings MIDI, audio, group and return tracks, tempo, locators, mixer settings with their automation and VST2 / VST3 plugins with their state; Simpler / Sampler and drum racks become LYNX SHARE samplers, and Live's other devices are listed in the import report.
u.0.1.25.n1: FL Studio Mobile (.flm): File › Open imports the arrangement, samples, drum kits and DirectWave programs, with rack levels, pan and routes. Samples are searched next to the .flm and in FL Studio's copy of the FLM resources; missing ones go to the Missing files window.
u.0.1.25.n2: 32-bit VST2 / VST3 plugins on Windows: they run through a bridge (LYNX-bridge32.exe) that adds no latency. A plugin that crashes in the bridge stops on its own while LYNX SHARE keeps playing.
u.0.1.25.n3: Video tracks and ADR: video clips on the Playlist with a SMPTE ruler, frame-by-frame moves, Extract the sound and Export with video (needs FFmpeg). For dialogue replacement there is a cue list with streamers, beeps and take comping. (#83)
u.0.1.25.n4: Clip-launch workflow (View › Layout style, optional): a clip grid with scenes next to the Playlist, with launch modes, quantisation, legato, loop and follow actions. Live sets bring their Session clips into it and export writes them back; the default Pattern workflow is unchanged.
u.0.1.25.n5: VCA faders and folding mixer groups: Group › VCA › New VCA from selected makes a VCA that can be automated and nested. Groups fold to their bus strip, and any effect with a side input has a Sidechain from picker in one menu.
u.0.1.25.n6: Comping: each pass of an audio loop recording lands on its own Playlist track, in a group. Comp these takes (right-click a track of the group) adds a comp track; drag across the take lanes to pick parts, then audition, crossfade and flatten.
u.0.1.25.n7: Automation lanes and modulators: optional automation lanes under Playlist tracks (off by default), and Tools › Modulators... adds an LFO or random source that moves a knob around its own value. Multilink to controllers (Ctrl+J) links the controls you move to the controllers you move next, as in FL Studio.
u.0.1.25.b0: Mixer routing stays put: moving, inserting or deleting mixer tracks keeps sends, sidechains, Fruity Send, Transmitter, Patcher and Voltage Controller outputs, automation and MIDI links on their track.
u.0.1.25.b1: Export to FL Studio: the exported project renders at the right length (FL's Thief demo came out at 8:12 instead of 3:59.9), and LYNX SHARE-only instruments rendered to audio play at unity in FL Studio (about 5 dB too loud before). Muted Playlist clips are written muted instead of being left out (#110), and clip fades are written so FL Studio plays them.
u.0.1.25.b2: Stretched samples follow FL's TIME knob: precomputed effects and Trim are applied first, then only the span that plays is stretched. In FL's Thief demo the ride cymbal played about 3x too fast; projects that combine TIME with Trim, a precomputed fade or a Start / Length region may sound different from before.
u.0.1.25.b3: Plugins in a separate process: this works on macOS too, and the plugin window does not float over other apps. Keys the plugin window does not use (Space, F-keys, your shortcuts) reach LYNX SHARE, and Esc closes the window. (#99)
u.0.1.25.b4: Linux: LV2 plugins are scanned once in one helper process; with 510 plugins the first scan went from 25 minutes to about 12 s (#85), and a plugin that crashes the scan is blacklisted (#90). The interface font is Open Sans, bundled, because labels were cut short with wider distribution fonts; Settings › General › Interface font picks any installed font.
u.0.1.25.f0: A plugin crashing in its own window closed LYNX SHARE on Windows. A message offers Save as... and Always run in a separate process instead. (#32)
u.0.1.25.f1: Third-party plugins with a side input get the slot's sidechain source, and the side input is on only while a source feeds it. Plugins such as RCompressor compress again. (#109)
u.0.1.25.f2: Audio tracks lost their mixer link when a project was reopened. (#122)
u.0.1.25.k0: Render to audio (an insert bounced to an audio clip) plays about 5 dB louder than the insert it replaces. A fix is planned.
u.0.1.25.k1: Live set export: LYNX SHARE's own instruments and effects are not converted (their tracks and notes are kept), effect-parameter automation and insert-to-insert routes are dropped, and Live trims overlapping audio clips. Live set import: racks keep their first chain, and Live's own effects are dropped.
u.0.1.25.k2: .flm import: FLM's effects are not imported yet, and a .dwp missing from FL Studio's copy of the FLM resources plays a stand-in.
u.0.1.25.k3: With several overlapping automation clips on one control, LYNX SHARE's choice can differ from FL Studio's. At a clip's start LYNX SHARE reaches the new value in about 8 ms, where FL Studio glides.
u.0.1.25.k4: A 32-bit or bridged plugin's editor opens in its own window.
u.0.1.25.k5: A tempo moved by a linked MIDI controller does not resize audio clips. Type or set the final tempo.
